options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: config
options.description: The name of the instance's configuration (similar but not quite the same as a region) which defines the geographic placement and replication of your databases in this instance. It determines where your data is stored. Values are typically of the form `regional-europe-west1` , `us-central` etc. In order to obtain a valid list please consult the [Configuration section of the docs](U(https://cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/instances)).

options.name: display_name
options.description: The descriptive name for this instance as it appears in UIs. Must be unique per project and between 4 and 30 characters in length.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: labels
options.description: An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique identifier for the instance, which cannot be changed after the instance is created. The name must be between 6 and 30 characters in length.

options.name: node_count
options.description: The number of nodes allocated to this instance. At most one of either node_count or processing_units can be present in terraform. .

options.name: processing_units
options.description: The number of processing units allocated to this instance. At most one of processing_units or node_count can be present in terraform. .

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP
